# skilllint

> Private lint of agent skills. Verdict + score + sha256, nothing leaves the machine.

Tools: `lint_skill(path)`, `compare_skills(paths)`, `lint_rules()`.

Checks: frontmatter, name, description and trigger, dead instructions, secret-shaped literals, prompt-injection and exfiltration markers, broken file references, oversized files, world-writable scripts, unbounded autonomy.

Verdict: PASS (>=80, no critical) | WARN | FAIL (any critical).

Install: `npx -y mcp-remote https://rta.lat/skilllint/mcp` or `python3 mcp_server.py` (stdio).

The returned sha256 can be signed by attest and enforced by drift as an allowlist. Locales: en, hi. India (Bharata) supported from day one; legal claims only from official sources, otherwise pending.
